scope: Multihead cache-safe Mirror structural equivalence + teacher-orbit code fitting; NOT a trained natural-language model, not a Mirror-specific capacity proof.
insertion: One shared dmodel-to-dhead QKV triple, H learned relative Query and post-attention output Mirror Views operating in parallel on a single canonical K/V. Repeat across layers is a later scope.

train.target: per-head full causal outputs MSE, not language NLL
train.data: disjoint Gaussian iid tensors from torch.Generator; world sets common physical QKV and head teacher, seed sets training/eval streams

teacher_families: off-orbit independent dense orthogonal head transforms
stronger_native_control: Full independent dense Q/output right maps per head can represent off-orbit teacher at greater code bytes; a pre-folded static Q/readout version is exact to linear Mirror and MUST be compared for speed.

mechanism_gates.head_causal: changing suffix cannot change output prefix
mechanism_gates.teacher_orbit_training: matching student heldout MSE < 1e-5 in >=2/3 fresh worlds and both seeds
mechanism_gates.different_attention_heads: pairwise head KL > 1e-5 on matching linear teachers
mechanism_gates.off_orbit: report every outcome; no expectation of Mirror advantage
mechanism_gates.mirror_specific_runtime: NO gate possible from this aligned synthetic head task alone; compare folded-native

capacity_accounting: folded per-head Q matrices if materialized persistently
canonical K/V bytes vs resident headwise caches
intermediate activation memory not assumed free
timed single decode vs full autoregressive throughput separately
freeze_limitations: synthetic teacher is aligned by construction
normal text inference and GPU not tested
nonlinear post-attention activation is NOT identical to per-token nonlinear cached V
static folding can eliminate Mirror runtime without adding model functional capacity
exact full sequence and cache provenance test remains future MA-691 scope
